note: Fourteen conflict patterns copied from the Stage 3 ontology. They are not DP-1 definitions and are not evaluated.

patterns.title: Different consent dates for the same evaluation
patterns.requiredComparableContext: Same activityType and same evaluation cycle.
patterns.temporalRules: Compare only instances linked to the same evaluation.
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Two verified dates for the same consent instance or same linked evaluation.
patterns.reviewQuestion: The documents give two consent dates. Which date did the school receive consent?
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Different evaluation completion dates
patterns.temporalRules: Report date may precede the overall completion.
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Same field, same instance, different verified values.
possibleExplanations: Report dated at typing, not completion
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Conflicting eligibility dates
patterns.temporalRules: Eligibility should precede or equal the IEP meeting.
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Two verified determination dates, or eligibility after the IEP meeting that relies on it.
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Assessment value differs across documents
patterns.requiredComparableContext: Same instrument, form, subtest/composite, score type, norm basis and administration date.
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: All comparability fields match and values differ.
patterns.reviewQuestion: The IEP and the evaluation give different numbers for the same test. Which is right?
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Goal baseline does not match cited evaluation value
patterns.requiredComparableContext: Goal cites that instrument/date and same unit.
patterns.temporalRules: Baseline date equals or follows the cited administration.
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Goal explicitly cites the score and values differ.
patterns.reviewQuestion: Where does this goal's starting number come from?
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Service frequency/minutes differ between records
patterns.requiredComparableContext: Same service line in the same IEP version.
patterns.temporalRules: Compare within one version; across versions it is a change, not a conflict (see CP-VERSION-CHANGE).
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Same version, different verified values (e.g. service grid vs LRE page).
patterns.reviewQuestion: The plan lists this service twice with different time. Which is correct?
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Goal date outside IEP dates
patterns.temporalRules: Goal date expected within IEP span.
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Goal date after effective end or before start.
patterns.reviewQuestion: This goal's date is outside the plan's dates. Is that intended?
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Progress report refers to a superseded goal
patterns.temporalRules: Report period after the newer IEP's start.
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Reported goal is only in an older version.
patterns.reviewQuestion: The progress report tracks a goal from the earlier plan. Is there progress data on the current goals?
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Recommendation not traceable to IEP
patterns.temporalRules: Recommendation from report in force at IEP development.
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Full IEP coverage and no link or PWN; otherwise NOT SHOWN, not conflict.
patterns.reviewQuestion: The evaluation recommended something I can't find in the plan. Where is it?
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Contradictory service descriptions
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Different verified setting/provider for same line.
patterns.reviewQuestion: Is this service delivered in class or outside it?
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Inconsistent placement statements
patterns.requiredComparableContext: Same version; school week length known.
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Stated percentage/minutes disagree with summed pull-out minutes beyond rounding (computed, C5).
patterns.reviewQuestion: The plan's percentage of time in class doesn't match the service minutes. Which is right?
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Current and historical records mixed
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Facts from a superseded version presented as current.
patterns.reviewQuestion: Which IEP is in effect now?
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Assessments compared without equivalence
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Not a conflict: block the comparison and raise a question.
patterns.reviewQuestion: These two tests measure differently, so their numbers can't be compared directly.
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

patterns.title: Provision changed between versions without amendment record
patterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Change mid-year with no amendment or meeting record.
patterns.reviewQuestion: Services changed between these two plans. Was there a meeting or amendment?
patterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.
